chapterInfo.content:
10
Ɔman no ahofadie ne ne nhyira
1Mommisa AWURADE hɔ
osuo bereamporɔberɛ mu!
AWURADE ma asraman paepae,
na ɔbɛma osuo atɔ pii ama wɔn,
na wɔn nyinaa anyinya mfuo mu nnuane.
2 # Mat 9.36 Na abusua honi no kaa ahuhusɛm,
na nkɔmhyɛfoɔ no hunuu atorosɛm
na wɔyii daeɛ hunu,
wɔde adehuhuo kyekyeree onipa werɛ.
Ɛno nti ɔman no tu kɔɔ sɛ nnwan,
wɔrebrɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ biara nni hɔ.
3 # Sak 11.5 Nnwanhwɛfoɔ no na me bo afu wɔn,
na saa mpapo no na mɛba abɛtwe wɔn aso.
Na asafo AWURADE rebɛhwɛ ne nnwankuo, Yuda fie,
na ɔde wɔn bɛyɛ sɛ n’animuonyam pɔnkɔ ɔsa mu.
4 # Yer 30.21 Ɔno mu na ntweaso tiboɔ
ne mpɛɛwa
ne akodie tadua bɛfiri aba,
ɔno mu na ahafoɔ nyinaa bɛbom afiri aba.
5Na wɔbɛyɛ sɛ nnɔmmarima
a wɔtiatia mmorɔno so dɔteɛ soɔ ɔko mu,
na wɔbɛdi ako;
ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE ne wɔn na ɛwɔ hɔ,
na apɔnkɔsotefoɔ anim bɛgu ase.
6Na mɛhyɛ Yuda fie aboɔduro,
na magye Yosef fie nkwa,
na mama wɔatena ase;
na me yam ahyehye me ama wɔn,
na wɔbɛyɛ sɛdeɛ mensumm wɔn nguiɛ,
na mene AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn,
na mɛgye wɔn so.
7Na Efraim bɛyɛ sɛ dɔmmarima,
na nsa nti wɔn akoma bɛtɔ wɔn yam,
na wɔn mma nso bɛhunu na wɔn ani agye,
na wɔn akoma adi AWURADE mu ahurisie.
8Mɛbɔ hwerɛma mafrɛ wɔn na maboa wɔn ano;
na magye wɔn,
na wɔbɛdɔ sɛdeɛ wɔdɔreeɛ no.
9 # Yes 66.19 Na mɛdua wɔn aman no mu,
na wɔbɛkae me akyirikyiri nsase so,
na wɔne wɔn mma bɛnya nkwa na wɔasane aba.
10Na mɛma wɔasane afiri Misraim asase so aba,
na mɛboa wɔn ano afiri Asiria,
na mede wɔn aba Gilead ne Lebanon asase so,
na wɔrennya kwan mpo mma wɔn.
11 # Eks 14.16; Yes 11.15 Na ɔbɛfa ahohiahia po no mu,
na wabobɔ ɛpo mu asorɔkyeɛ,
na Asuo Nil mu mmonhwa nyinaa awewe.
Na Asiria ahantan no bɛbrɛ ase,
na Misraim poma bɛfiri akɔ.
12Na mɛhyɛ wɔn den, AWURADE mu,
na ne din mu na wɔbɛnanteɛ, AWURADE asɛm nie.

Mommisa AWURADE hɔ
osuo bereamporɔberɛ mu!
AWURADE ma asraman paepae,
na ɔbɛma osuo atɔ pii ama wɔn,
na wɔn nyinaa anyinya mfuo mu nnuane.
Na abusua honi no kaa ahuhusɛm,
na nkɔmhyɛfoɔ no hunuu atorosɛm
na wɔyii daeɛ hunu,
wɔde adehuhuo kyekyeree onipa werɛ.
Ɛno nti ɔman no tu kɔɔ sɛ nnwan,
wɔrebrɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ biara nni hɔ.

Nnwanhwɛfoɔ no na me bo afu wɔn,
na saa mpapo no na mɛba abɛtwe wɔn aso.
Na asafo AWURADE rebɛhwɛ ne nnwankuo, Yuda fie,
na ɔde wɔn bɛyɛ sɛ n’animuonyam pɔnkɔ ɔsa mu.
Ɔno mu na ntweaso tiboɔ
ne mpɛɛwa
ne akodie tadua bɛfiri aba,
ɔno mu na ahafoɔ nyinaa bɛbom afiri aba.
Na wɔbɛyɛ sɛ nnɔmmarima
a wɔtiatia mmorɔno so dɔteɛ soɔ ɔko mu,
na wɔbɛdi ako;
ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE ne wɔn na ɛwɔ hɔ,
na apɔnkɔsotefoɔ anim bɛgu ase.

Na mɛhyɛ Yuda fie aboɔduro,
na magye Yosef fie nkwa,

na me yam ahyehye me ama wɔn,
na wɔbɛyɛ sɛdeɛ mensumm wɔn nguiɛ,

na mɛgye wɔn so.
Na Efraim bɛyɛ sɛ dɔmmarima,

Mɛbɔ hwerɛma mafrɛ wɔn na maboa wɔn ano;
na magye wɔn,
na wɔbɛdɔ sɛdeɛ wɔdɔreeɛ no.
Na mɛdua wɔn aman no mu,
na wɔbɛkae me akyirikyiri nsase so,
na wɔne wɔn mma bɛnya nkwa na wɔasane aba.
Na mɛma wɔasane afiri Misraim asase so aba,
na mɛboa wɔn ano afiri Asiria,
na mede wɔn aba Gilead ne Lebanon asase so,
na wɔrennya kwan mpo mma wɔn.
Na ɔbɛfa ahohiahia po no mu,
na wabobɔ ɛpo mu asorɔkyeɛ,
na Asuo Nil mu mmonhwa nyinaa awewe.
Na Asiria ahantan no bɛbrɛ ase,
na Misraim poma bɛfiri akɔ.
Na mɛhyɛ wɔn den, AWURADE mu,
na ne din mu na wɔbɛnanteɛ, AWURADE asɛm nie.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
